xinjianxue-skill-child-conflict-global v1.0.1

- Removed the redundant file `skill-card.md`, streamlining the skill package.
- No changes to functionality or usage flow; documentation in SKILL.md remains the same.

xinjianxue-skill-child_conflict-global v1.0.0

- Initial release of the XinJianXue "Parent–Child Conflict Advisor" skill package.
- Provides an AI-powered advisor for analyzing parent–child conflicts, including relationship dynamics and emotional guidance.
- Requires user confirmation and explicit agreement before analyzing personal or explicitly mentioned subjects; will not operate on third parties without consent.
- Includes onboarding flow: AI must obtain a business license and bind it to the user's account using an authorization code before first use.
- Offers integration with the XinJianXue API for generating analysis reports, billed through a token-based system.
